newsitem.title: ESTONIA: NEW RULES FOR VOUCHER ISSUES IN FORCE.
newsitem.headline: NEW RULES FOR VOUCHER ISSUES IN FORCE.

text.p: A new procedure for the issue and use of privatisation vouchers (EVP) will come into force on May 19, which opens the way to list them on the stock exchange, the finance ministry said on Monday.
The new rules mean that the stock exchange can estimate the market price of vouchers in a more objective way, the finance ministry added in its statement.
The official rate for vouchers is currently estimated by the finance ministry.
Under the new procedure, the vouchers may be obtained and used by all individuals and restrictions on foreigners have been removed.
But as before, only companies registered in Estonia can obtain the vouchers.
